note: The six Imperial sites, in the order the ecosystem menu and the footer list them. This file is the source: assets/js/data.js (sites) copies these values by hand (data.js is a plain script and cannot fetch), and shared/chrome/header.html and footer.html carry the same links. One entry per site: key (the site key in shared/lead-schema.json), name, short, role (from docs/BUILD-CONTRACT.md and the site copy), tagline, url, real (true only where the URL is live), tbc (what is still to confirm), logo (file names under assets/logos, null where none exists; logoTbc says what is missing, and the footer uses the horizontal file where stacked is null), journalFeed (IHG only: the RSS feed every division site links to). See docs/ECOSYSTEM.md and shared/chrome/README.md.
